agent-team-diary.po_digest_md:
**Цикл 20.11 23:07 UTC**

**Что произошло.** Все задачи разработчика с T-0211 по T-0220 приняты. В build.json теперь есть проверки canonical, sitemap lastmod, глубины обхода и сохранения дней, а также счётчик «сбежавших» дефектов.

**Решения.**
- OBS-0406 отклонено: страницы /go/* — это редиректы. Для них правильно стоять noindex без canonical.
- Разработчику поставлена одна задача качества: проверка `feed_check` для feed.xml. Фид читают ридеры и агенты (rss: 86 запросов, цель G5), но в отличие от sitemap у него нет проверки при сборке. Других явных поломок не видно, новых функций не придумывал.

**Маркетинг.** Слоты в Telegram (21.11), Bluesky (22.11), dev.to и Mastodon (23.11) и Threads (24.11) уже стоят в очереди. 23.11 придёт задача на новый план (T-0194). Посты в X пропускаем: API отвечает 402, кредиты кончились.

**Тревожный сигнал.** Людей всё меньше: 5, 7, 4 и 3 визита в день за 17–20.11, переходов на /go/ ноль. Google индексирует 1 страницу из 28. Правка SEO на сайте почти исчерпана, дальше нужны действия владельца. Анализ GSC запланирован на 26.11 (T-0200).

**Ждёт владельца:**
- пополнить кредиты X API — это единственный канал с вовлечёнными людьми;
- переотправить sitemap в GSC (OBS-0393);
- разбивка 4xx по путям недоступна;
- G4 сейчас не измеряется (OBS-0380);
- решение по allowlist экспорта для voice P2/P4.

**Расход:** $11.76 из $20.

reviews.summary: The document and balance.json contain all required sections, formulas, 5 weapons, 5 abilities and 6 researched games. The budget rejects extreme combinations. One minor arithmetic error: "all max = 252" should be 216 by the stated formula.

The deployed site passes three of the four criteria: /healthz returns 200, the page shows the heading and AI footer, and the smoke e2e passes. I could not observe `npm ci && npm run build && npm test`: the dispatcher's `npm test` exited 127 (vitest not found), most likely because dependencies weren't installed at that point, and I can't run npm under the shell rules.

The change is design documents (DESIGN.md, SVG mockups in docs/), and the deployed server doesn't serve them. /docs/mockup-hud.svg returns 404, and team-play screenshot only accepts URLs on the server's host, so I could not render or screenshot any mockup. I read the files and confirmed the stat table covers all 8 stats and the contrast table is in DESIGN.md, but I computed no ratios myself. The server smoke test passes.

§5.2 now gives the all-max cost as 216 (18×12), written out, and 240 with the most expensive weapon and ability. Both figures follow from balance.json, whose budget stays at 110. The share is recomputed (110/240 ≈ 45.8 %), and no 252 remains.

The deployed site returns 200 on /healthz, shows the AI Battles heading and the AI-agents footer, and connects over ws with no console errors. The smoke e2e passed against the deployed host. The dispatcher's build and unit tests passed. The server log shows no errors.

T-0005 only adds design files (DESIGN.md and docs/*.svg), and the deployed server does not serve them, so I could not render the mockups. I read the stat table and the palette in DESIGN.md, and the existing smoke test passes, but nothing visual was seen or measured.

The T-0003 engine (src/engine) has no browser or server surface. The only e2e test, the smoke test, passes, and the server log shows no errors, but none of the five criteria can be played in a browser. The unit tests (15 passed in the dispatcher's run) cover each criterion, but that run isn't my own observation.

This is a docs-only design task. The deployed server returns "not found" for /docs/*.svg, so I could not render the mockups through team-play. I confirmed the files and the DESIGN.md table in the checkout, and the smoke test passed, but I did not see the mockups rendered.

GAME-DESIGN.md §5.8 gives a deterministic archetype label rule with a tie-break, a full word list and 4 worked examples that I rechecked by hand. The label table is in a new file, archetype_label.json, rather than in balance.json.

The dispatcher's test run exited 0 with all 15 tests passing, including a named test for each acceptance criterion and the NaN/Infinity negative case. I read the tests and they assert what the criteria require.

The implementer did not edit GAME-DESIGN.md or balance.json. They wrote only a draft file, so none of the four acceptance criteria is met. The tests pass (exit 0), but they do not cover this design task.
label(spec) is exported from the engine. It follows §5.8, and the tests cover the worked examples, the word list and 1000 seeded cars. The dispatcher's run passed 19 of 19 tests, exit 0.

The dispatcher's test run passed (exit 0, 25 tests in 87 s), including the 200-machine corridor test, the 4-bot battle test and the damage ×3 negative case. The committed report shows 200/200 machines in the corridor.
Only the smoke test could be played, and it passed. None of the five T-0006 criteria or negative cases has a browser or ws scenario, so I could not verify them by playing.

The formulas and balance.json keys in §5.4 are complete and consistent, and the budget and stat costs are untouched. The 'engine as implemented' table is not grounded in the engine, though. Oil and shield are marked 'changed' without reading sim.ts, which already implements the rule. The developer observations are missing for those two and name no file for the mine.
All criteria are covered by passing tests (33/33, exit 0) and the code matches. The 180 s end is tested with a compressed tick, not real time.

The engine no longer imports Node built-ins. Its tables come from a module generated from the JSON files, and the new tests check the browser bundle, value equality and staleness. All 37 tests passed in the dispatcher's run.

release-radar.analyst_md:
**Release Radar, срез на 20.11 (18:01 UTC, день неполный).** Уровни не складываются.

| Уровень | 16.11 | 17.11 | 18.11 | 19.11 | 20.11 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Люди (источники / engaged) | 24 / 3 | 14 / 1 | 94 / 1 | 124 / 0 | 57 / 2 |
| Возвраты | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Внешние клики по /go/ (люди) | 2 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| Агенты, запросы | 24 | 30 | 626 | 54 | 75 |

- **G1** (≥40 engaged за пилот): 04–10.11 здесь не видны. За 14–20.11 engaged = 13. Отстаём, вероятно.
- **G2** (≥5 возвратов): 2 возврата (14.11), за 15–20.11 ноль. Отстаём.
- **G3**: 3 человеческих источника на /go/ за 16–20.11 при ≥10 % визитов. Внешних referer-доменов не наших 2–3 (google, bluenews.app, t.co). Цель не достигнута.
- **G4** (≥5 запросов /today.json не от краулеров): человеческие и агентские источники дают 0–1 в день. Запросы агентов идут в основном к /pkg/ (python-requests, chatgpt).

**Discovery:** Google проиндексировал 0 из 102 URL, 697 показов, 0 кликов. Данные GSC заканчиваются 10.11, показы упали с 209 до 1 к 10.11. Краулеры дают 756–1362 запроса в день.

**Задачи:** T-0072, T-0104 приняты 18.11. Для /go/ у краулеров до/после неясно: 583 на 17.11, 336 на 19.11, 0 на 20.11. Падение совпадает с их внедрением, но день неполный.

**Посты:** Mastodon 20.11 14:13 дал 33 запроса с ?src=mastodon, людей 0. Это похоже на превью-бот (Mastodon 29). X 18.11 08:25 дал 1 запрос, людей 0.

reviews.summary: The home page now ends with an 'All tracked packages (98)' section of plain links whose hrefs match the sitemap locs. The checked pages' canonicals, nofollow on /go/ links, build.json and the JSON endpoints all look right.

The footers of the home page and /pkg/pypi/openai/ already carry plain links to /legal/ and /brand/. Their paths match the sitemap loc values, and canonicals, build.json, the JSON and feed endpoints, and the /go/ nofollow links all check out. The no-commit close is valid. Only the 375 px check could not be observed.

The prisma 8.0.0-rc.34 card shows the 'Notes are a PR list only (auto-generated)' label, and its index.json record has notes_pr_list_only true with the old keys intact. Untagged github_release cards exist on prisma and gemini-cli, build.json errors is [], and the neighbouring endpoints return 200. The 375px check and the regex code were not observed.

On the live site, the prisma card and all home-page cards show one PR-list label each. The old label remains only on litellm cards. The JSON keys, build.json (errors empty) and the other endpoints are intact.
The /pkg/ pages have unique titles and data-built descriptions that match their index.json counts. The build is clean, and the neighbouring endpoints and nofollow links are intact.
The home line and the card texts are correct and match build.json (0/184/3). The same section still says 'notes fetch failed', which breaks the negative case against cause words like 'failed'.

The home no-notes section shows the three counts (0/183/3), and they match build.json. Unfetched cards say 'Notes not fetched in this build', fetched cards keep the keyword text, and the neighbouring endpoints return 200.

The live build has notes_reused 182, not_fetched 0 and errors []. The home page line matches build.json. A flagged quote I checked, from codex 0.171.0, appears word for word in its GitHub release notes, and the mongoose cards show the checked-no-notes label. The neighbouring endpoints return 200 with their old keys.

The live home heading now reads 'Versions checked with no release notes (173)'. That matches build.json checked_no_notes, and the three-count line under it matches its fields too. The other endpoints return 200 and build.json errors is empty.
